gaps.sentence: He was ___ (COURAGE) enough to speak first.
The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.

gaps.sentence: The village is ___ (ACCESS) only by boat.
gaps.explanation: 'Accessible' = easy to reach; the -ible spelling follows 'access'.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is unknown.
gaps.explanation: 'Depth' — noun from deep (spelling change: deep → depth).

gaps.sentence: The mountain road has been ___ (WIDE) to cope with coach traffic.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'has been widened' — the verb form meaning made wider.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (GRATE) for all their support.
His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.
